key_insight: LEAP combines a perovskite-tuned LLM with active learning to prioritize precursor additives using mechanism-aware, uncertainty-guided discovery instead of trial-and-error screening.
engineering_relevance: The framework can reduce search cost and improve hit selection for solar-cell additive discovery by turning literature knowledge into actionable design descriptors.
method: Trains a domain-specialized LLM on perovskite additive literature to extract mechanism-relevant knowledge.
Converts candidate molecules into interpretable descriptors for use in Bayesian optimization.
Uses an expert-in-the-loop closed loop to filter feasibility and iteratively refine additive rankings.
evidence_signal: On unseen literature benchmarks, the domain-specialized model outperformed general-purpose models, and proof-of-concept screening across three rounds yielded average device PCEs of 20.13% and 20.87% versus 19.25% for the control, with a champion PCE of 21.32%.
watch_item: The results are preliminary and depend on expert review and low-data Bayesian optimization, so broader generalization and automation remain to be validated.
paper_title: LEAP: A closed-loop framework for perovskite precursor additive discovery
